description: Source code for a WebSocket implementation in Go, including connection handling, codecs for message serialization, error definitions, and configuration structures.

classes.name: ProtocolError
classes.description: Represents WebSocket protocol errors with an error string.

classes.name: Addr
classes.description: Implementation of net.Addr for WebSocket, holding a URL.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration settings for WebSocket connections, including URL, protocol, TLS, headers, and dialer.

classes.name: Conn
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection with methods for reading, writing, closing, and retrieving connection info.

classes.name: Codec
classes.description: A pair of functions for marshaling and unmarshaling WebSocket message payloads.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error string for ProtocolError.

methods.name: Network
methods.description: Returns 'websocket' as the network type.

methods.name: NewFrameReader
methods.description: Creates a new frame reader for WebSocket frames.

methods.name: NewFrameWriter
methods.description: Creates a new frame writer for WebSocket frames.

methods.name: HandleFrame
methods.description: Handles a WebSocket frame, possibly transforming it.

methods.name: WriteClose
methods.description: Sends a close frame with a status code.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from a WebSocket frame.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data as a WebSocket frame.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: IsClientConn
methods.description: Checks if the connection is client-side.

methods.name: IsServerConn
methods.description: Checks if the connection is server-side.

methods.name: LocalAddr
methods.description: Returns local address info for the connection.

methods.name: RemoteAddr
methods.description: Returns remote address info for the connection.

methods.name: SetDeadline
methods.description: Sets read/write deadlines for the connection.

methods.name: SetReadDeadline
methods.description: Sets read deadline for the connection.

methods.name: SetWriteDeadline
methods.description: Sets write deadline for the connection.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket configuration.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the WebSocket.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a marshaled message as a frame over WebSocket.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives a frame from WebSocket and unmarshals it.

methods.name: marshal
methods.description: Helper to marshal string or byte slice into frame data.

methods.name: unmarshal
methods.description: Helper to unmarshal frame data into string or byte slice.

methods.name: jsonMarshal
methods.description: Marshal data into JSON frame.

methods.name: jsonUnmarshal
methods.description: Unmarshal JSON frame data into a variable.
